message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up_halv: Cut in two. Drag yourself while you can, or hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up_hurt: %s too hurt to pull yourself together, and nothing to stand on. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.rise_hint_cr: You're down, with nothing to stand on. Hold sneak to pull yourself together
message.jaymospowers.downed.rising_crawl: Hauling yourself up on your arms... [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.risen_crawl: You pull yourself together. With nothing to stand on, you crawl on.
message.jaymospowers.downed.up_crawl: You've come round. With nothing to stand on, you crawl on.
message.jaymospowers.downed.revived_craw: %s has come round, though they've nothing to stand on (your %s went to them).
message.jaymospowers.downed.heal_struggl: With the %s, you pull yourself together. With nothing to stand on, you crawl on.
message.jaymospowers.downed.self_revived: Second Wind! You find the strength to carry on, crawling.
message.jaymospowers.downed.bed_ready_cr: Rested enough: hold sneak to pull yourself together, or lie on and keep mending.
message.jaymospowers.downed.fire_rise_cr: Warmed through by the fire. Hold sneak to pull yourself together
